sloka: राज्ञो दशरथस्येष्टः पितुर्मे मुनिपुङ्गवः ।सखा परमको विप्रो वाल्मीकिः सुमहायशाः ।। ७.४७.१६ ॥
transliteration: rājño daśarathasyeṣṭaḥ piturme munipuṅgavaḥ ।sakhā paramako vipro vālmīkiḥ sumahāyaśāḥ ।। 7.47.16 ॥

translations.english: Lakshmana informs Sita that the highly renowned sage Valmiki, who is a dear and supreme friend to his father King Dasharatha, resides here.
